title: Orc Raiders
html:
Orcs are raiding out of their compound north of Underleaf. The watch pays for twelve. Report to Sergeant Ilsa Varne by the notice board. (Sergeant Ilsa Varne)

About

Given bySergeant Ilsa Varne
Level10
LengthShort
KindSide
Quest points0

What you need

Nothing to bring.

Steps

  1. Talk to Sergeant Ilsa Varne (outdoors near Underleaf) to get the quest.
  2. Kill 12 orcs (12)
  3. Report to Sergeant Ilsa Varne in Underleaf at -62, 206

Rewards

Reward
Gold180
Character XP7,000

What Sergeant Ilsa Varne says

Sergeant Ilsa Varne: Twelve orcs. That's twelve fewer coming down the north road at night.

Sergeant Ilsa Varne: They'll send more. They always do. The watch pays either way.

Handing it in

"The orcs will be back. So will the board."
